description: Words become awkward clicks, persuasion falters and crafting slows. Your body is fragile. You can still choose, speak and act; Rosine has not made you a mindless creature.

name.str: Bound protection: Child of the false valley

description: Your master and their marked servants leave you alone while you keep the pact. This protects you alone; it does not command demons or make them loyal to your companions.

name.str: Lesser senses: Child of the false valley

description: Words become awkward clicks, persuasion falters and crafting slows. Your body is fragile. You can still choose, speak and act; Rosine has not made you a mindless creature.

name.str: Body: Child of the false valley

description: Your permanent insectlike body grants +1 dexterity and +8 speed. Its fragility and difficulties with speech and crafting remain. Returning to human shape is impossible.

name.str: Borrowed impulse: Child of the false valley

description: Your limited fighting impulse requires recent service to your living master. The body and its weaknesses remain if the bond breaks, but this impulse falls silent.

name.str: Pawn: Child of the false valley

description: The limited servant’s body is complete. Neither more flesh nor the master’s death will turn it into an independent apostle. Your choices remain your own, but the pact has a lasting price.
